transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?

I'm... well, I'm here because everyone keeps acting like I'm making things up. But I know what I see. My wife's relative... he's been coming into the house. To get at me. 

My tools in the garage don't just move themselves. And... my fishing plans. Every weekend, something happens to spoil them, and it's not an accident. It's been going on for months. It's just... plain as day to me. He's trying to take over my place. Push me out. That's why I'm here.
Besides noticing these things happening, have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people around you don't seem to hear or see?
No. I don't... I don't hear voices or anything. It's nothing like that. I just see what's right in front of me. The things he messes with. That's all.
You mentioned this has been going on for months—can you tell me more specifically when you first started noticing these things happening, and has it been continuous since then?
About... nine months, I guess. Give or take. It started right when my wife's relative moved into the house. And... yeah, it hasn't stopped since.

Aside from these concerns about your wife's relative, how have things been going for you day-to-day—are you still working, managing your usual responsibilities, and keeping up with relationships the way you were before this started?

Everything else is fine. I still get up... go to the plant. Do my assembler work. Keep the bills paid. I take care of myself like I always have. 

The only trouble... it's all just centered on the house. What he's doing with my things. That's all.
Have you had any recent head injuries, neurological problems, medical illnesses, or been using alcohol or drugs around the time these beliefs started?
No. Nothing like that. I haven't hit my head or been sick. And I don't... I don't do drugs or anything. My health is fine. There's nothing wrong with me.
